definitions.single_phase_depth: Maximum GPU-to-GPU logical tree depth D; switch hops do not add logical rounds.
definitions.allreduce_dependency_depth: 2D: longest reduce-then-broadcast dependency chain for the saved paired trees.
definitions.bandwidth_objective: B_inf=max_e((L_AG(e)+L_AG(reverse(e)))/capacity(e)); fixed saved tree weights, overlapped phases, M=N.
definitions.sequential_rs_ag_objective: Sum of separate reduce-scatter and allgather congestion times; may exceed B_inf.
definitions.alpha_beta: No numerical alpha/beta substituted. 2D and B_inf are separate coefficients; their sum with alpha/beta is a latency+congestion estimate, not a verified finite-packet makespan.
definitions.scope: Upstream equal-shard allgather trees and their reversal for allreduce; not the paper Appendix G allreduce-optimization LP.

deadline_override.method: Suspend only the Python timeout waiter; Java worker continues unchanged; always resume waiter.
